title: Scenarij 4: incident sa AI agentom za podršku
summary: Indirektni prompt injection kroz otrovani dokument u bazi znanja preuzima agenta za podršku, koji izvlači podatke kupaca kroz run_sql i šalje ih napolje preko send_email i http_get: istraga tragova agenta i loga e-mail gateway-a, obuzdavanje, politika čuvara alata i mapiranje na OWASP LLM Top 10 i MITRE ATLAS.
title_en: Scenario 4: An incident with an AI support agent
summary_en: An indirect prompt injection in a poisoned knowledge base document hijacks a support agent, which pulls customer data with run_sql and sends it out through send_email and http_get: investigating agent traces and the email gateway log, containment, a tool guard policy and mapping to the OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS.
